validated_results.title: Design and progress of a trial of selenium to prevent prostate cancer among men with high-grade prostatic intraepithelial neoplasia.
validated_results.journal: Cancer epidemiology, biomarkers & prevention : a publication of the American Association for Cancer Research, cosponsored by the American Society of Preventive Oncology
validated_results.reason: This article only introduces the rationale and accrual progress of an ongoing selenium prevention trial ("introduces the rationale for, and progress to date"), reporting no original prostate cancer incidence results.

validated_results.title: An overview of the health effects of isoflavones with an emphasis on prostate cancer risk and prostate-specific antigen levels.
validated_results.reason: The paper is a narrative overview summarizing eleven prior trials of isoflavones and PSA rather than an original study of prostate cancer incidence.

validated_results.title: An overview of the health effects of isoflavones with an emphasis on prostate cancer risk and prostate-specific antigen levels.
validated_results.reason: The paper is an "overview of the health effects of isoflavones" synthesizing existing trials, not original human data on incident prostate cancer.

validated_results.title: A review of the animal models used to investigate the health benefits of soy isoflavones.
validated_results.reason: This is a review of animal-model literature on soy isoflavones ("This review considers the recent literature in which animal models were used"), with no original human incidence data.

validated_results.title: A review of the animal models used to investigate the health benefits of soy isoflavones.
validated_results.reason: The article is a narrative review of animal studies of soy isoflavones and provides no original human prostate cancer incidence results.

validated_results.title: Nutrition and cancer: the current epidemiological evidence.
validated_results.reason: The article reviews "the current scientific evidence on the relationship between nutrition and the most frequent tumours" rather than reporting an original analysis.

validated_results.title: Dairy products and health: a review of the epidemiological evidence.
validated_results.reason: The study is explicitly "a review of the epidemiological evidence of dairy products and health" and reports no original incidence estimates.

validated_results.title: High bone density is associated with prostate cancer in older Afro-Caribbean men: Tobago prostate survey.
validated_results.reason: The measured exposure is hip bone mineral density as a hypothesized surrogate, not any assessed calcium intake or calcium biomarker ("Hip BMD was measured by dual X-ray absorptiometry").

validated_results.title: High bone density is associated with prostate cancer in older Afro-Caribbean men: Tobago prostate survey.
validated_results.reason: Vitamin D is mentioned only incidentally as part of a speculative surrogate concept ("a possible surrogate of lifetime exposure to hormone/growth factor/vitamin D/calcium exposure"), with bone density as the actual exposure measured.

validated_results.title: Role of epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) in the treatment of breast and prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: The article is a narrative review that will "highlight the important in vitro mechanistic actions elicited by EGCG" and contains no original human incidence analysis.

validated_results.title: Role of epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) in the treatment of breast and prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: This review of EGCG mechanisms and trials in breast and prostate cancer treatment presents no original data on developing prostate cancer.

validated_results.title: Are men with low selenium levels at increased risk of prostate cancer?
validated_results.reason: The publication is a pooled meta-analysis of twenty prior epidemiologic studies ("A meta-analysis was undertaken"), not an original human study.
